```odin
import timebase "fire:timebase"
```

Time representations and conversions.

The engine's source of truth is `Sample_Time` (i64 frames since transport zero).
Every other representation is derived from it:

  Sample_Time <-> Seconds          via sample rate
  Seconds     <-> Beats            via Tempo_Map (supports linear tempo ramps)
  Beats       <-> Ticks            via PPQ
  Beats       <-> Bar_Beat_Tick    via Tempo_Map meter changes

"Beat" always means a quarter note, whatever the time signature. Musical
beats in the meter's denominator are computed in BBT.

## Constants

### DEFAULT_PPQ

```odin
DEFAULT_PPQ :: 960
```

Default tick resolution, in pulses (ticks) per quarter note.

## Types

### Tempo_Point

```odin
Tempo_Point :: struct {
	start: Beats,
	bpm_start: f64,
	bpm_end: f64,
}
```

A tempo segment starts at `start` beats with `bpm_start` and ramps linearly
(in beats) to the next segment's start, reaching `bpm_end`. If bpm_end == bpm_start
the tempo is constant. The last segment extends forever at bpm_start, and any
ramp on it is ignored.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `start` | where the segment begins |
| `bpm_start` | tempo at `start` |
| `bpm_end` | tempo reached at the *next* point's start |

### Meter

```odin
Meter :: struct {
	numerator: i32,
	denominator: i32,
}
```

A time signature, e.g. {6, 8} for 6/8.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `numerator` | beats per bar, in units of the denominator |
| `denominator` | 2, 4, 8, 16 ... |

### Meter_Point

```odin
Meter_Point :: struct {
	bar: i64,
	meter: Meter,
}
```

Meter changes happen on bar boundaries.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `bar` | 0-based bar index where this meter begins |
| `meter` |  |

### Bar_Beat_Tick

```odin
Bar_Beat_Tick :: struct {
	bar: i64,
	beat: i64,
	tick: i64,
}
```

A musical position as bar, beat and tick, all 0-based. Beats count in the
meter's denominator (eighths in 6/8), unlike `Beats`, which are quarter notes.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `bar` | 0-based |
| `beat` | 0-based, in units of the meter denominator |
| `tick` | 0 ..< ticks per denominator beat |

### Tempo_Map

```odin
Tempo_Map :: struct {
	tempos: [dynamic]Tempo_Point,
	meters: [dynamic]Meter_Point,
	seconds_at: [dynamic]Seconds,
	meter_beats: [dynamic]Beats,
}
```

Built and edited on the control thread. The audio thread may read a map that
is no longer being mutated (publish a new one with an atomic swap).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `tempos` | sorted by start; the first starts at beat 0 |
| `meters` | sorted by bar; the first starts at bar 0 |
| `seconds_at` | Derived: seconds at each tempo point. Rebuilt by `tempo_map_rebuild`. |
| `meter_beats` | Derived: start beat of each meter point. |

### Sample_Time

```odin
Sample_Time :: i64
```

Absolute position in frames since transport zero. The engine's source of truth for time.

### Seconds

```odin
Seconds :: f64
```

A time in seconds.

### Beats

```odin
Beats :: f64
```

Musical time in quarter notes, whatever the time signature.

### Ticks

```odin
Ticks :: i64
```

Musical time in whole ticks; `ppq` ticks make one quarter note.

### Quantize

```odin
Quantize :: enum u8 {
	None,
	Bars_8,
	Bars_4,
	Bars_2,
	Bar,
	Half_T,
	Half,
	Half_D,
	Quarter_T,
	Quarter,
	Quarter_D,
	Eighth_T,
	Eighth,
	Eighth_D,
	Sixteenth_T,
	Sixteenth,
	Sixteenth_D,
	Thirty_Second_T,
	Thirty_Second,
	Thirty_Second_D,
}
```

A musical grid length for quantizing launches and edits. `_T` is a triplet
(2/3 of the length), `_D` dotted (3/2). Bar lengths follow the meter.

## Procedures

### tempo_map_init

```odin
tempo_map_init :: proc(m: ^Tempo_Map, bpm: f64 = 120, meter: Meter = Meter{4, 4}, allocator: mem.Allocator = context.allocator) -> runtime.Allocator_Error
```

Control thread. Initializes `m` with one tempo (`bpm`) and one meter, both
starting at zero. Allocates with `allocator`; free with `tempo_map_destroy`.

### tempo_map_destroy

```odin
tempo_map_destroy :: proc(m: ^Tempo_Map)
```

Control thread. Frees everything `tempo_map_init` allocated and zeroes `m`.

### tempo_map_set_tempo

```odin
tempo_map_set_tempo :: proc(m: ^Tempo_Map, at: Beats, bpm: f64, ramp_to: f64 = -1) -> runtime.Allocator_Error
```

Control thread. Inserts or replaces the tempo point at beat `at` with `bpm`.
`ramp_to` > 0 ramps linearly (in beats) to that tempo at the next point; < 0
means constant until the next point. May grow the map's arrays.

### tempo_map_set_meter

```odin
tempo_map_set_meter :: proc(m: ^Tempo_Map, bar: i64, meter: Meter) -> runtime.Allocator_Error
```

Control thread. Inserts or replaces the meter change at 0-based `bar`.
May grow the map's arrays.

### tempo_map_rebuild

```odin
tempo_map_rebuild :: proc(m: ^Tempo_Map)
```

Control thread. Recomputes the derived tables (`seconds_at`, `meter_beats`).
The setters call it; call it yourself only after editing `tempos` or
`meters` directly.

### beats_per_bar

```odin
beats_per_bar :: proc "contextless"(meter: Meter) -> f64
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Length of one bar of `meter` in quarter notes (6/8 gives 3).

### tempo_at

```odin
tempo_at :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, b: Beats) -> f64
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Tempo in BPM at beat `b`, following ramps.

### beats_to_seconds

```odin
beats_to_seconds :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, b: Beats) -> Seconds
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts a beat position to seconds since transport zero, following
tempo changes and ramps.

### seconds_to_beats

```odin
seconds_to_beats :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, t: Seconds) -> Beats
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts seconds since transport zero to a beat position. Inverse of
`beats_to_seconds`.

### samples_to_beats

```odin
samples_to_beats :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, s: Sample_Time, sample_rate: f64) -> Beats
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts a frame position at `sample_rate` (Hz) to a beat position.

### beats_to_samples

```odin
beats_to_samples :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, b: Beats, sample_rate: f64) -> Sample_Time
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts a beat position to frames at `sample_rate` (Hz), rounding to
the nearest frame.

### meter_at_beat

```odin
meter_at_beat :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, b: Beats) -> (meter: Meter, bar_start: i64, beat_start: Beats)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The meter in effect at beat `b`, with the 0-based bar and the beat
position where that meter begins.

### beats_to_bbt

```odin
beats_to_bbt :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, b: Beats, ppq: i64 = DEFAULT_PPQ) -> Bar_Beat_Tick
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts a beat position to bar/beat/tick, with `ppq` ticks per quarter
note. Ticks are rounded to the nearest whole tick.

### bbt_to_beats

```odin
bbt_to_beats :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, bbt: Bar_Beat_Tick, ppq: i64 = DEFAULT_PPQ) -> Beats
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts bar/beat/tick (with `ppq` ticks per quarter note) to a beat
position. Inverse of `beats_to_bbt`.

### tempo_slope_at

```odin
tempo_slope_at :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, b: Beats) -> f64
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Tempo ramp at beat `b`, in bpm per beat (0 when constant).

### next_change_after

```odin
next_change_after :: proc "contextless"(m: ^Tempo_Map, b: Beats) -> (at: Beats, ok: bool)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The first tempo point or meter change strictly after beat `b`, or
ok = false if there is none.

### samples_to_seconds

```odin
samples_to_seconds :: proc "contextless"(s: Sample_Time, sample_rate: f64) -> Seconds
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts frames to seconds at `sample_rate` (Hz).

### seconds_to_samples

```odin
seconds_to_samples :: proc "contextless"(t: Seconds, sample_rate: f64) -> Sample_Time
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts seconds to frames at `sample_rate` (Hz), rounding to the nearest frame.

### beats_to_ticks

```odin
beats_to_ticks :: proc "contextless"(b: Beats, ppq: i64 = DEFAULT_PPQ) -> Ticks
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts beats to ticks at `ppq` ticks per quarter note, rounding to the nearest tick.

### ticks_to_beats

```odin
ticks_to_beats :: proc "contextless"(t: Ticks, ppq: i64 = DEFAULT_PPQ) -> Beats
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Converts ticks to beats at `ppq` ticks per quarter note.

### beats_to_seconds_at

```odin
beats_to_seconds_at :: proc "contextless"(b: Beats, bpm: f64) -> Seconds
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Duration of `b` beats at a constant tempo of `bpm`.

### seconds_to_beats_at

```odin
seconds_to_beats_at :: proc "contextless"(t: Seconds, bpm: f64) -> Beats
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Beats elapsed in `t` seconds at a constant tempo of `bpm`.

### samples_per_beat

```odin
samples_per_beat :: proc "contextless"(bpm: f64, sample_rate: f64) -> f64
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Frames per quarter note at a constant tempo of `bpm` and `sample_rate` (Hz). Not rounded.

### ramp_beats

```odin
ramp_beats :: proc "contextless"(bpm: f64, slope: f64, t: Seconds) -> Beats
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Beats travelled in `t` seconds from a tempo of `bpm` that changes by
`slope` bpm per beat (a linear ramp in beats, as in `Tempo_Map`). `slope` 0
is a constant tempo.

### ramp_seconds

```odin
ramp_seconds :: proc "contextless"(bpm: f64, slope: f64, b: Beats) -> Seconds
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). Seconds taken to travel `b` beats from a tempo of `bpm` changing by
`slope` bpm per beat. Inverse of `ramp_beats`.

### quantize_length

```odin
quantize_length :: proc "contextless"(q: Quantize) -> (bars: int, beats: Beats)
```

**Realtime-safe** (callable on the audio thread). The length of `q` as whole bars (`bars` > 0; `beats` is 0), or as
quarter notes (`bars` is 0). `.None` gives both 0.
